get.description: Use this API action to list the audit journal, newest first, with combinable filters (administrators only)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index of the first entry to return (default 0)

parameters.name: actorId
parameters.description: Only the entries of this author (a deleted account included)

parameters.name: occurredFrom
parameters.description: Lower bound, inclusive: ISO 8601 date-time with a zone (Z or offset)

parameters.name: occurredTo
parameters.description: Upper bound, inclusive: ISO 8601 date-time with a zone (Z or offset), not before occurredFrom

200.description: Page of journal entries and number of entries matching the filters

get.description: Use this API action to get the values offered by the filters of the journal screen, taken from the journal itself (administrators only)

200.description: Authors, actions, object types and scopes found in the journal

get.description: Get the current user. If there is no logged user (header or cookie), it returns an empty object

200.description: Only if cookie is not set to true

post.description: Delete the JWT from the cookies

get.description: Use this API action to list the groups with their members and scopes

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The index of the first element to return (integer from 0 to 2147483647, default 0)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of elements to return (integer from 1 to 100, default 10)

post.description: Use this API action to create a group with its members and scopes in one request

patch.description: Use this API action to change the name, members and/or scopes of a group. Provided fields replace the current values

get.description: Use this API action to list the scopes, sorted by code

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The index of the first element to return (integer from 0 to 2147483647, default 0)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of elements to return (integer from 1 to 100, default 10)

post.description: Use this API action to create a scope

patch.description: Use this API action to rename a scope. The code cannot be changed

503.description: One or more services are unhealthy

get.description: Use this API action to list users (administrators only)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The index of the first element to return (integer from 0 to 2147483647, default 0)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of elements to return (integer from 1 to 100, default 10)

200.description: List of users with their groups

post.description: Use this API action to create a new user, optionally in some groups

get.description: Use this API action to get a single user. An ordinary user can only read their own account

patch.description: Use this API action to change the role and/or the groups of a user

post.description: Use this API action to create the accounts of the valid rows of a preview (administrators only, once per file)

get.description: Use this API action to list, page by page, the faults found in the preview of an accounts file

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index of the first entry to return (default 0)

200.description: One page of (row, column, reason) entries and their total

post.description: Use this API action to analyse an accounts file (.xlsx or .csv) without creating anything

200.description: Counts of the analysis and identifier of the preview

get.description: Use this API action to get the columns, formats and limits of the accounts import (administrators only)

200.description: Columns expected in the file and limits of the import
